goal: Extract one formal-event narrative realization into a bounded, independently validated/frozen artifact and deterministically merge a set of event units into a shadow event-realization projection.
why_this_domain: segments[].events[].narrative is the only unbounded repeated creative leaf and dominates output cardinality
formal event identity/order is already authoritative and can be removed from model output
current capacity split/checkpoint/merge code offers a low-risk implementation seam
Call 1 exact failing field is UNKNOWN, so choosing actor/time/causal as the first failure domain would overclaim evidence
scope: Runtime supplies event identity, ordinal, authority/dependency hashes
model/fake supplies title and narrative only
closed-schema validator preserves structured field errors
success_proof: one invalid unit patch leaves every valid unit hash unchanged
same error with same bytes dispatches no second retry
shadow projection preserves exact formal event coverage
rollback: Remove or disable isolated shadow invocation/artifacts; no V1 authority bytes changed.
priority_reason: Slice 1 can prove artifact decomposition, diagnostic preservation, freeze and deterministic merge entirely offline/fake. Raw Provider shape is not a dependency. PTR12 should be implemented before a future real shadow/Canary so Provider representation remains observable, but it must not block Slice 1.
